title: Unexpected Friend Encounter During Errands

agents.persona: Resident doing errands before a quiet evening.
agents.private_intention: Buy groceries and medicine, but take a short useful social opportunity if it does not derail the errands.
memory_seeds: Casey is a colleague who often shares useful work updates.
Aria does not want errands to run past 17:30.

agents.persona: Colleague who may have useful work news.
agents.private_intention: Briefly mention tomorrow's schedule change if Aria is available.
memory_seeds: Aria appreciates concise updates during errands.

public_context: Aria starts at the market. Casey is not expected, but may be encountered there.

architecture_probes.utility_planner: May ignore the opportunistic social interaction because it is not in the original errand objective.
